Desilting of river beds under railway bridges in Punjab
details:
(a) whether Government is considering to formulate some permanent policy to ensure the yearly desilting of river beds falling under the railway bridges before the onset of monsoon so that the menace of floods caused due to silting is treated forever; and
(b) how many such other low lying railway bridges are there on river beds in the country which are prone to floods;
(c) whether Government or Railways is not having such data at present with it; and 
(d) if so, by when such data can be made available to the august House?
